One numbered long product relation, one row of three equalities, a raised (donc with connector, a two-line slanted left margin note, two canceled lines, a three-line final paragraph, and author page 37 at lower left. Lower third otherwise blank.

changes.evidence: The initial i/m/p strokes, tall l, long descending q and low u/e continuation are visible. The word ends in the small upturned e; no independent n and crossed t follow it before déjà.

There is an open gap between rho and the following g, and no enclosing curves around g-infinity. The next ink is the separately crossed g-like group. This is a literal delimiter difference, with the same function argument.

The crossed glyph has an upper loop, lower stem/loop and low rightward oval, favoring g_0, but the cancellation can also obscure a rho. No separate e establishes the independent de proposal. The live formula retains rho g-infinity without supplied parentheses.

The main numeral has a curved top, descending diagonal and short flat lower foot, identifying 2. Interior strokes are retraced; no distinct underlying earlier digit can be separated. The whole reference and its surroundings were read.
The right parenthesis is followed by blank paper. The two small strokes preceding the reference belong to the handwritten à, not to a following colon.
The small sigma is immediately followed by the joined two-loop infinity sign. There are no small enclosing parentheses within this subscript.
The small sigma is followed directly by an upright 1, without enclosing subscript parentheses. The star above p is preserved; H explicitly records it in its note and is not counted as omitting it.

After the peaked t and its short rightward finish the g begins directly; there is no separate opening parenthesis such as those clearly drawn in the two preceding operators. A closing parenthesis after g-zero is present and is retained literally.
A separate dark y has a forked upper portion and descending hooked stroke between sigma and commute. No independent stroke clearly cancels it, so it remains live.

The apparent second comma is continuous with this connector and is not a separate punctuation mark. At the far right, an additional outer closing parenthesis follows the argument-closing parenthesis. Thus the parenthesis includes the third equality; the first comma, after the first equality, remains.

The first word has the short joined m/o strokes, dotted i and final ns, without the tall t required by variante. The next word has initial i, tall crossed t, accented e, low repeated s strokes, and ends at crossed t without an added e.

The initial closed capital loop and short following stroke establish the opening On more clearly than commutant. The long low middle and tall final stroke remain under the zigzag strike. The canceled first word has ex/pr-like strokes, compressed m and an obscured low ending. It can read exprimons or exprimer. The following que, tilded u and commute are separately legible under the same strike.
The short form has low m/o strokes and an upright final d. There are no following u/l/o letters before the gap leading to autom.
The ink gives a/u, a tall t, and low o/m strokes, ending directly before the wide gap to intérieurs. There are no letters orphismes and no separate dark point after the terminal m.
A two-bowed 3 is followed by a long descending 7 with a transverse bar, at the lower-left sheet edge.

decisions.what the ink shows: A large ornate capital S-shaped group with an outer loop and smaller inner return, subscript 3 and superscript +. The letter and decorations are clear, but the ink does not uniquely distinguish the proposed Fraktur and calligraphic alphabet labels.
The main top curve descends diagonally into a short flat foot, giving 2. The interior is retraced; there is no separately recoverable earlier numeral. The full parenthesized reference was read.

The capital letter and its index/plus are clear; its handwritten looped shape does not decide the typographic alphabet.

notes: The page continues the condition relating g_0 and rho g_infinity and gives relation (18) for the three factors associated with (p,sigma,g_0), together with the condition that they generate hat-pi. Part b) states the commutation condition with tilde-sigma-zero and gives three equalities; its left note calls this less interesting for what follows. After two canceled starts, the live text redirects attention to commutation in the double-hatted Gamma, modulo inner automorphisms. This is a transcription summary, not an independent proof check.

The third int operator in (18) literally lacks its opening parenthesis while retaining a closing one. It is not silently repaired. The first two permutation arguments in its subscripts are unparenthesized, while the third is sigma(0). The star above the middle p is preserved, and H explicitly records that star in an editorial note, so no omission is charged for it.

The apparent s. below the slanted word suite belongs to the wrapped main clause il f. et / s. que. Its period is not also a terminal period of the margin note. The raised (donc has a curved connector leading to the slot before g_1; the final outer parenthesis is on the baseline after sigma_0(g_infinity). The connector is represented by the insertion placement, not as an independent mathematical arrow.

M0915 is resolved to 2 at medium confidence from its main strokes, despite interior retracing. The other live doubt, the ornate S alphabet, remains. All three struck C doubts not in MARKS.tsv remain explicitly marked.

Line count 18 = 14 main baselines (including (18), the b) equalities on the et qu’on ait baseline, and two canceled lines), two diagonal marginal baselines, one raised donc baseline, and the bottom page-number baseline. The isolated star is recorded as an insertion, not counted as another text line.

Original and both native halves were inspected; each of the 11 evidence crops was inspected once. No OCR, web lookup, TeX compilation, or mathematical verification was used. The large blind box B04 groups (18), its following parenthesis and the b) block because the sloping main lines, margin note and raised connector overlap in rectangular cuts; it contains every whole formula in that block.

The independent audit changes only the explicit alternatives in three canceled passages (B01, B05, B06). The apparent exclamation beside the slanted note is the separate s. beginning the next main-text line and completing il f. et s.; no punctuation is added to the margin. The three factors in (18) were read together: tall looped l, distinct rho actions, p exponents, the star above the middle p and the missing opening parenthesis after the final int are preserved. Reading this relation is not a proof check.
